title: Simultaneous EEG and fMRI signals during sleep from humans
description: This dataset contains simultaneous EEG and BOLD fMRI recordings from 33 healthy participants scanned at Penn State, including resting-state and sleep sessions. EEG was acquired with a 32-channel MR-compatible system, and the data are accompanied by sleep stage scores for each 30-second epoch. It supports investigation of autonomic and neural events during transient arousal changes across sleep.
methods_description: Each scanning session comprised an anatomical scan, two 10-minute resting-state runs (before and after a visual-motor adaptation task), and several 15-minute sleep runs. EEG was recorded with a 32-channel Brain Products MR-compatible system, with R128 markers corresponding to fMRI volume triggers. Sleep stages were scored per 30-second epoch.
